unmet: RQCLA-2: `_ZBUILD_CLAIM_HOLDER` is set by `zbuild_claim_acquire` (in `core/claim/claim.sh`) AFTER the run-status sidecar is already spawned (`_runner_status_comment_spawn` at line ~2381 of `main()`, before the claim at line ~2456). The sidecar is a separate `exec bash` process and cannot see `_ZBUILD_CLAIM_HOLDER`—it is not exported, and was not set at spawn time. When the sidecar calls `rsc_render_header`, `${_ZBUILD_CLAIM_HOLDER:-}` is empty, so `<!-- zbuild-holder: -->` is never inserted. The test (`claim-coordinator-unit-test.sh` DSCLA-2) only calls `rsc_render_header` directly in-process with the variable manually set; it does not test the sidecar's ability to include the holder, so the gap is invisible to CI. — core/claim/claim.sh | _ZBUILD_CLAIM_HOLDER="$holder"
